pagedata.pyLabel: BPM API: Add child work objects to a case
pagedata.pyDescription: THIS ACTIVITY CREATES ONE OR MORE COVERED CASES OR TASKS. IF PAGEPROPERTY CONTAINS A PAGELIST OR PAGEGROUP, THE ACTIVITY CREATES A WORK OBJECT FOR EACH ENTRY. IF PAGEPROPERTY CONTAINS AN EMBEDDED PAGE OR IS BLANK, A SINGLE CHILD OBJECT IS CREATED. THE CLASS OF THE CREATED CHILD WORK OBJECTS IS THE VALUE OF CHILDCLASS, IF PRESENT, OR THE CLASS OF THE PAGE OR ENTRY IN PAGEPROPERTY OTHERWISE. IF AN EMBEDDED PAGE, PAGELIST, OR PAGEGROUP IS SPECIFIED, THE ACTIVITY WILL COPY DATA FROM THE EMBEDDED PAGE OR ENTRY TO THE CHILD. IF COPYPAGEDATA IS SET TO "TRUE" AND DATATRANSFORM IS NOT SET, ALL PAGE DATA FROM THE PARENT OR THE ENTRY IN PAGEPROPERTY IS COPIED TO THE CHILD. IF DATATRANSFORM CONTAINS THE NAME OF A VALID DATA TRANSFORM RULE FOR THE CHILD CLASS, THAT RULE IS APPLIED TO THE CHILD UPON ITS CREATION. IF THE DATA TRANSFORM HAS A PARAMETER FOR THE NAME OF THE PARENT PAGE, PASSING IN THE NAME OF THE DATA TRANSFORM PARAMETER TO SOURCEPAGEPARAMNAME WILL ALLOW DATA TO BE COPIED FROM THE PARENT PAGE OR PAGEPROPERTY ENTRY IN THE DATA TRANSFORM RULE. NOTE - WHEN BOTH COPYPAGEDATA IS SET TO TRUE AND A DATA TRANFORM IS SPECIFIED, THE COPYPAGEDATA PARAM IS IGNORED.

rowdata.pxWarningMessage: Use of the Commit activity method interferes with the PRPC transaction model and may result in stale database records. Consider removing; In most cases, PRPC already does a commit at the end of the transaction.

Writing application logic using the Java activity method impacts maintainability, discourages reusability, and increases risk during upgrades. Use this method only when necessary. If executing Java code is required, consider using the Call-Function activity method to execute a Function rule. Using Function rules encourages creating well-defined input and output parameters and can be reused across many different types of rules.
